stories.headline: Nvidia revealed as tenant behind Hut 8's 1GW Texas campus in leases worth up to $50B

key_facts.fact: Nvidia has signed leases worth up to $50 billion for Hut 8's Texas data center, the Financial Times reported on Tuesday July 28, citing five people familiar with the deal
key_facts.excerpt: July 28 (Reuters) - Nvidia has signed leases worth up to $50 billion for Hut 8's Texas data center, the Financial Times reported on Tuesday, citing five people familiar with the deal.

key_facts.fact: Hut 8 said last week its 1-gigawatt Beacon Point campus had a base-term contract value of $19.6 billion over 15 years, rising to as much as $50.2 billion if renewal options are exercised
key_facts.excerpt: Hut 8 said last week its 1-gigawatt Beacon Point campus had a base-term contract value of $19.6 billion over 15 years, rising to as much as $50.2 billion if renewal options are exercised.

key_facts.fact: The deal covers two 15-year leases at Hut 8's Beacon Point campus in Nueces County near Corpus Christi; Hut 8 announced a first 352-MW lease worth $9.8 billion and doubled it with a second 352-MW lease on July 20
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia is the counterparty behind two 15-year leases at Hut 8's Beacon Point campus in Nueces County, near Corpus Christi... Hut 8 announced the first 352-MW lease weeks earlier, worth $9.8bn on a triple-net basis over 15 years, then doubled it on July 20 with a second 352-MW lease that brought the campus's base-term value to $19.6bn.

key_facts.fact: Beacon Point sits on 525 acres with a gigawatt of utility capacity secured through an interconnection agreement with AEP Texas and is being built to Nvidia's DSX reference architecture for gigawatt-scale AI factories
key_facts.excerpt: Beacon Point sits on 525 acres with a gigawatt of utility capacity secured through an interconnection agreement with AEP Texas, and it is being built to Nvidia's DSX reference architecture for gigawatt-scale AI factories.

key_facts.fact: The facility will house hundreds of thousands of Nvidia GPUs, and Nvidia could sublease capacity to its 'neocloud' partners that buy its GPUs and sell AI cloud computing
key_facts.excerpt: The facility will house hundreds of thousands of Nvidia graphics processing units, according to the report... Once completed, Nvidia could sublease capacity to its 'neocloud' partners that purchase its GPUs and sell AI cloud computing services.

key_facts.fact: Hut 8 raised about $4.3 billion in bonds in June at 6.129%, priced roughly 100 basis points above Nvidia's 30-year corporate bonds on the strength of the long-term lease
key_facts.excerpt: To raise capital for the first phase of the project, Hut 8 issued about $4.3 billion in corporate bonds at an annual interest rate of 6.129% in June. Based on Nvidia's long-term lease, the bonds were priced at about 100 basis points above Nvidia's 30-year corporate bonds.

stories.headline: Meta and BlackRock form venture for $14B, 1GW El Paso data center with BlackRock owning 80%

key_facts.fact: Meta and BlackRock announced on July 28 a venture to develop and own a data center campus in El Paso, Texas, with 1 gigawatt of compute capacity, expected to begin coming online in 2028
key_facts.excerpt: MENLO PARK, Calif. and NEW YORK, July 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Meta Platforms, Inc. (NASDAQ: META) and BlackRock, Inc. (NYSE: BLK) today announced a venture to develop and own a data center campus in El Paso, Texas... will have 1 gigawatt of compute capacity... the venture expects to begin bringing this capacity online in 2028.

key_facts.fact: Funds managed by BlackRock will own 80% of the venture and Meta 20%, with the parties funding their pro rata share of roughly $14 billion in total development costs
key_facts.excerpt: Funds managed by BlackRock will own an 80% interest in the venture, while Meta will retain the remaining 20% ownership. The parties have committed to fund their respective pro rata share of the approximately $14 billion in total development costs.

key_facts.fact: At financial close Meta contributes land and construction-in-progress worth about $2.3 billion, BlackRock contributes about $4.9 billion in cash, and Meta receives a one-time distribution of about $1 billion
key_facts.excerpt: At financial close, Meta will contribute the venture land and construction-in-progress assets valued at approximately $2.3 billion, and BlackRock will make a cash contribution of approximately $4.9 billion. Meta will receive a one-time distribution of approximately $1 billion.

key_facts.fact: Part of BlackRock's investment will be funded with proceeds from a $12.5 billion debt financing
key_facts.excerpt: A portion of BlackRock's investment will be funded with proceeds from a $12.5 billion debt financing.

key_facts.fact: Meta will provide construction, administrative and property management services and will be the initial sole occupant of the campus, which it had earlier described as a more than $10 billion project among 28 US data centers it operates or is building
key_facts.excerpt: Meta earlier said it was building an over $10 billion data center project in El Paso, near the Texas-New Mexico border, among 28 data centers it has in either operation or under construction in the U.S.

key_facts.fact: The structure keeps most of the $14 billion project off Meta's own books while Meta stays on as construction manager, property manager and sole tenant once servers come online in 2028
key_facts.excerpt: Meta has folded its half-built El Paso data centre into a joint venture with BlackRock, formalising a structure that keeps most of a $14bn project off its own books.

stories.headline: AMD locks up 529MW of Core Scientific capacity with option to reach 2.5GW, worth $14B

key_facts.fact: AMD on Tuesday July 28 signed a deal with Core Scientific to secure up to 2.5 gigawatts of data center capacity, with more than 500 megawatts available starting in 2027
key_facts.excerpt: July 28 (Reuters) - AMD on Tuesday signed a deal with Core Scientific to secure up to 2.5 gigawatts of data center capacity as the chip firm expands infrastructure to meet growing demand for AI computing... more than 500 megawatts of Core Scientific's AI-ready data center capacity starting in 2027.

key_facts.fact: The agreements cover about 530 megawatts across five sites under 15-year contracts and represent more than $14 billion of potential base contracted revenue for Core Scientific
key_facts.excerpt: Core Scientific (NASDAQ: CORZ) has agreed to provide Advanced Micro Devices with about 530 megawatts of US data-center capacity under 15-year contracts... The agreements span five sites and represent more than $14 billion of potential base contracted revenue.

key_facts.fact: AMD received market-priced warrants for up to 30 million Core Scientific shares at an exercise price of $23.47, vesting as megawatts are contracted
key_facts.excerpt: As part of the arrangement, AMD received warrants for up to 30 million shares of CORZ stock at an exercise price of $23.47 per share. Those warrants vest based on actual megawatts contracted.

key_facts.fact: The capacity will host customers deploying AMD Instinct GPUs, EPYC CPUs and the ROCm software stack, with the companies jointly designing the physical facilities
key_facts.excerpt: The companies will collaborate on designing the physical infrastructure and rolling out AMD Instinct GPUs and EPYC CPUs, with ROCm software underpinning the planned AI systems. The capacity is meant to serve customers deploying AMD products, not AMD's own computing needs.

key_facts.fact: The deal lifts Core Scientific's total leased customer capacity to about 1.1 gigawatts, representing more than $24 billion in potential contracted revenue, as the former bitcoin miner completes its pivot to AI hosting
key_facts.excerpt: total leased customer capacity has risen to about 1.1 gigawatts... more than $24 billion of potential contracted revenue

key_facts.fact: The warrant structure reverses AMD's earlier deals with OpenAI and Meta, in which AMD granted customers performance-based warrants; here AMD receives the right to invest in the infrastructure provider
key_facts.excerpt: In transactions with OpenAI and Meta Platforms Inc., AMD granted its customers performance-based warrants tied to purchases and deployment milestones. Under the Core Scientific arrangement, AMD is receiving the right to invest in the infrastructure provider.

stories.headline: Taiwan detains an Nvidia employee in AI chip smuggling probe, a first for the chipmaker

key_facts.fact: Taiwan's Keelung District Prosecutors' Office said on Tuesday July 28 it had detained a man surnamed Chang on suspicion of falsifying business documents after searching his home and workplace on July 24
key_facts.excerpt: Taiwan's Keelung District Prosecutors' Office said on Tuesday it has detained a man surnamed Chang on suspicion of falsifying business documents, after investigators searched his home and his workplace on July 24 in connection with the AI chip smuggling case it opened in May.

key_facts.fact: Bloomberg reported Chang works for Nvidia and that the search covered his desk at Nvidia's Taipei office, which would make it the first known legal action against an Nvidia employee in a chip diversion case
key_facts.excerpt: Taiwanese prosecutors have detained an Nvidia Corp. employee and searched the company's offices as part of a widening probe into the alleged smuggling of AI accelerators into China... The move may be the first known instance of government authorities taking legal action against an employee of the chipmaker.

key_facts.fact: Seven people are now being held in the probe, including the Nvidia employee, two Super Micro staff and one from Taiwan-listed Albatron Technology, accused of forging documents to ship roughly 50 Super Micro servers to China
key_facts.excerpt: Seven people are now being held as part of the probe, including the Nvidia employee, two from Super Micron and one from Taiwan-listed Albatron Technology. They are accused of forging documents to ship roughly 50 servers made by Super Micro to China.

key_facts.fact: An Nvidia spokesperson said 'Smuggling is a nonstarter,' adding the company primarily sells to well-known partners including OEMs who help ensure sales comply with US export control rules
key_facts.excerpt: "Smuggling is a nonstarter," an Nvidia spokesperson told Tom's Hardware. "We primarily sell our products to well-known partners, including OEMs, who help us ensure that all sales comply with U.S. export control rules."

key_facts.fact: Taiwan has no law criminalizing the export of AI chips to China, so every detention in the case has rested on fraud and document-forgery accusations
key_facts.excerpt: Taiwan doesn't treat the unauthorized export of AI chips to China as a crime, which is why every detention in the case has so far concerned fraud accusations.

key_facts.fact: This was the third round of searches, after May detentions of three people and late-June detentions of two Super Micro workers; in March the US Justice Department charged three people tied to Super Micro with helping smuggle at least $2.5 billion of US AI technology to China
key_facts.excerpt: The latest action was part of a third round of searches in the investigation, following earlier rounds in May and June... In March, the U.S. Justice Department charged three people associated with Super Micro, including one of its co-founders, with helping smuggle at least $2.5 billion worth of U.S. AI technology to China.

stories.headline: Seoul's KOSPI crashes 10.8% as Samsung and SK Hynix sink on China chip fears

key_facts.fact: The KOSPI closed down 732.09 points, or 10.84%, at 6,023.66 on Tuesday July 28, after a marketwide circuit breaker halted trading for 20 minutes at 10:14 a.m.
key_facts.excerpt: The benchmark Korea Composite Stock Price Index (KOSPI) lost 732.09 points, or 10.84 percent, to close at 6,023.66, after plunging to 5,830.39 at one point... At 10:14 a.m., the bourse operator activated a marketwide circuit breaker to halt trading of KOSPI-listed shares for 20 minutes.

key_facts.fact: SK Hynix nosedived 14.65% to 1.55 million won and Samsung Electronics plummeted 13.39% to 220,000 won; SK Square fell 15.6% and chip equipment maker Hanmi Semiconductor 12.22%
key_facts.excerpt: Market bellwether Samsung Electronics plummeted 13.39 percent to 220,000 won, and SK hynix nosedived 14.65 percent to 1.55 million won. SK Square, the parent of SK hynix, plunged 15.6 percent to 925,000 won, and Hanmi Semiconductor, a leading chip equipment manufacturer, slumped 12.22 percent.

key_facts.fact: It was the KOSPI's worst session in about five months and Samsung's biggest daily loss since October 2008; SK Hynix's US-listed ADRs fell to a record low, below their IPO price
key_facts.excerpt: South Korean shares tumbled nearly 11% on Tuesday in their worst session in about five months... Memory-chip maker SK Hynix sank 14.7% after its American depositary receipts (ADRs) fell to a record low in New York and dropped below their initial U.S. offering price. Samsung Electronics... fell 14.4% in its biggest daily loss since October 2008.

key_facts.fact: A Bloomberg gauge of Asian semiconductor shares slumped as much as 7.5%, the most since early March, with a report that a Chinese state-backed company began mass producing immersion DUV lithography machines fueling competition fears
key_facts.excerpt: A Bloomberg gauge of Asian semiconductor shares slumped as much as 7.5%, the most since early March, tracking overnight declines in US peers. A report that a Chinese state-backed company has begun mass producing immersion deep ultraviolet lithography machines fueled fears over rising competition. Meanwhile, Nvidia Corp.'s $750 billion in AI infrastructure deals added to worry over AI-related debt levels.

key_facts.fact: Analysts tied the rout to CXMT's blockbuster Shanghai debut the previous day, which stoked fears the Chinese memory maker will erode the DRAM oligopoly of Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron
key_facts.excerpt: Analysts said investor sentiment deteriorated further after CXMT's blockbuster Shanghai debut the previous day fueled concerns over intensifying competition in the memory chip market.

key_facts.fact: Korean financial authorities said they were considering additional measures to curb demand for single-stock leveraged ETFs linked to Samsung and SK Hynix, blamed for amplifying volatility
key_facts.excerpt: In a bid to curb wild swings in chip stocks, financial authorities said they were considering additional measures to curb demand for single-stock leveraged exchange-traded funds (ETFs) linked to Samsung Electronics and SK hynix.

stories.headline: EPA says off-grid power plants built for data centers escape Clean Air Act acid rain rules

key_facts.fact: The EPA declared on Monday July 27 that power generators which do not sell electricity to the grid are not subject to Clean Air Act acid rain standards
key_facts.excerpt: EPA declared Monday that power generators that don't sell power to the grid aren't beholden to Clean Air Act acid rain standards.

key_facts.fact: The guidance states that under 'the best reading' of the Clean Air Act, 'islanded' plants like those used exclusively to power data centers are not covered by the cap-and-trade program for sulfur dioxide or curbs on nitrogen oxides
key_facts.excerpt: EPA's new guidance states that 'under the best reading' of the Clean Air Act, 'islanded' power plants like those used exclusively to power data centers aren't subject to EPA's cap-and-trade program for sulfur dioxide or its curbs on nitrogen oxides.

key_facts.fact: EPA Assistant Administrator Aaron Szabo wrote in a July 16 clarification to regional administrators that the Acid Rain Program 'does not apply to power generation facilities that are not connected in any way to the larger electricity grid'
key_facts.excerpt: "The EPA believes that, considering the plain text of these definitions, the Acid Rain Program does not apply to power generation facilities that are not connected in any way to the larger electricity grid," EPA Assistant Administrator Aaron Szabo wrote in the July 16 clarification.

key_facts.fact: The Acid Rain Program, created by the 1990 Clean Air Act amendments, applies only to fossil-fuel-fired units that sell electricity, so islanded facilities fall outside the statutory definition of a utility unit
key_facts.excerpt: According to the EPA, the Acid Rain Program applies only to fossil fuel-fired combustion devices that sell electricity. Because islanded facilities do not sell electricity to the grid, the agency said they do not meet the statutory definition of a utility unit covered by the program.

key_facts.fact: A growing number of proposed AI data centers plan dedicated natural-gas plants rather than grid connections; the clarification does not alter other federal or state permitting requirements
key_facts.excerpt: a growing number of proposed AI data centers [plan] to build dedicated natural gas-fired power plants to supply their own electricity rather than connect to the regional power grid... does not alter other federal or state environmental permitting requirements that may apply.

stories.headline: Corning beats on AI fiber demand but weak guidance sends shares down as much as 14%

key_facts.fact: Corning reported second-quarter core sales of $4.74 billion, up 17%, and core EPS of $0.78, up 30% year over year, on Tuesday July 28
key_facts.excerpt: Corning reported second-quarter core earnings of $0.78 per share, up 30% year over year, and core sales of $4.74 billion, up 17%, on Tuesday.

key_facts.fact: Shares slid 14% in premarket trading and were down about 11.2% after the release, as third-quarter guidance of $4.9-$5.0 billion in core sales and $0.85-$0.89 core EPS fell short of consensus of $4.99 billion and $0.85
key_facts.excerpt: Shares slid 14% in premarket trading following the release... Corning's third-quarter outlook called for core EPS in a range of $0.85 to $0.89 and core sales between $4.9 billion and $5 billion. Analysts had expected third-quarter sales of $4.99 billion and earnings of $0.85 per share.

key_facts.fact: Optical Communications sales grew 32% to $2.07 billion, including a 65% increase in Enterprise Networks, with Gen AI product sales growing significantly faster
key_facts.excerpt: Optical Communications grew sales 32% to $2.07 billion, including a 65% increase in Enterprise Networks, with Gen AI product sales growing significantly faster.

key_facts.fact: In the quarter Corning signed a multiyear, multibillion-dollar deal to supply optical fiber, cable and connectivity for Amazon's US data centers, and a long-term Nvidia partnership to expand US optical connectivity manufacturing capacity tenfold and US fiber capacity by more than 50%
key_facts.excerpt: Amazon announced a multiyear, multibillion-dollar agreement under which Corning will supply the optical fiber, cable, and connectivity solutions that power Amazon's expanding data center infrastructure... NVIDIA and Corning announced a long-term partnership in which Corning will expand its U.S.-based optical connectivity manufacturing capacity by 10x and expand its U.S. fiber production capacity by more than 50%.

key_facts.fact: Under its upgraded Springboard plan Corning targets an annualized sales run rate of $20 billion by end-2026, $30 billion by end-2028 and $40 billion by end-2030, implying a 19% sales CAGR from Q4 2026 to Q4 2030
key_facts.excerpt: Under its upgraded Springboard Plan, Corning aims for an annualized sales run rate of $20 billion by end-2026, $30 billion by end-2028, and $40 billion by end-2030, and expects a 19% sales CAGR from Q4 2026 to Q4 2030.
